# 1. Series and Parallel Circuit

Given:

- R1 = 15 Ω
- R2 = 30 Ω
- R3 = 50 Ω
- V = 12 V

## Series Circuit

Equivalent resistance:

Req = R1 + R2 + R3

Req = 15 + 30 + 50 = 95 Ω

Current:

I = V / R

I = 12 / 95 ≈ 0.126 A

### Final Answers (Series)

- Equivalent Resistance: 95 Ω
- Current: 0.126 A

---

## Parallel Circuit

Equivalent resistance:

1/Req = 1/15 + 1/30 + 1/50

1/Req ≈ 0.1133

Req ≈ 8.82 Ω

Current:

I = V / R

I = 12 / 8.82 ≈ 1.36 A

### Final Answers (Parallel)

- Equivalent Resistance: 8.82 Ω
- Current: 1.36 A
